initial.name: tool_discover
initial.description: Find and load additional tools. Search English keywords from the task, or provide exact tool names. Matching tools become available on the next request and remain loaded for this session.

query.description: Keywords in tool names or descriptions; empty string lists the first available tools.

names.description: Exact tool names to load instead of a keyword search.

changes.name: read
changes.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2.
